body:
## Pull request overview

This PR consolidates v3.0 completion status and restructures the v4.0 enterprise readiness roadmap based on a comprehensive codebase audit. The documentation update simplifies completed work into collapsible summaries and organizes future v4.0 development into three staged milestones (alpha, beta, GA).

**Changes:**
- Updated audit metrics to reflect actual state: 175 schemas (up from 171), 195 test files with 5,269 tests, 25 service contracts, 14 packages
- Collapsed ~500 lines of completed v3.0 Phase 5–11 task tables into a summary table with expandable details
- Restructured v4.0 roadmap from flat Phase 12–17 list into 3 staged releases with clear timelines (13 weeks total)
- Aligned DX_ROADMAP.md metrics and cross-references with main roadmap updates

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| ROADMAP.md | Major restructure: v3.0 completion summary + protocol domain coverage table, collapsed completed phases, staged v4.0 planning (alpha/beta/GA), parallel tracks section |
| DX_ROADMAP.md | Updated metrics to match audit findings, collapsed completed Phases 1–3 into details blocks, confirmed Phase 4 as active (2/10 tasks complete) |

The Protocol Domain Coverage table appears to have inconsistent schema counts. The header states "175 Zod schemas" total, but adding up the "Schemas" column (excluding contracts which are listed as "25 svc" meaning service interfaces, not schemas) gives: 19+18+27+25+32+14+8+7+5+9+4+4+1+1 = 174, which is one short of the claimed 175 total.

Please verify the per-domain schema counts against the actual codebase. Either the total of 175 is incorrect, or one of the domain counts needs to be adjusted by +1.

The Protocol Domain Coverage table test counts may also be inconsistent. The header states "195 test files" total, but adding up the "Tests" column gives: 20+18+27+25+26+14+8+7+5+9+4+4+25+1+1 = 194, which is one short of the claimed 195 total.

Please verify the per-domain test file counts against the actual codebase. Either the total of 195 is incorrect, or one of the domain counts needs to be adjusted by +1.
